notes.title: oOme Update 1.1 LeaderBoard
notes.content:
[b]This update includes : [/b]

Corrections for success triggers :

[i]- Unlock the score multiplier x4
- The achievement for reaching a score of 2000.[/i]

But also a World LeaderBoard !

notes.title: Next Update
notes.content:
We are actively working on the next [b]Update[/b].

This one will include the fix for the triggering of achievements, notably for the following achievements :

[i]- Unlock the score multiplier x4[/i]
[i]-The achievement for reaching a score of 2000.[/i]

We are also doing our best to implement a global [b]Leaderboard[/b] so that you can compare your progress with other players.

Thank you for your support !

Tezkatoz Production.
